patents.title: Generation of glow effect
patents.description: A method for generating a glow effect in an image, comprising: selecting an area within a rendered scene that is to glow to produce a selected area image based on a determination of luminance of scene elements in the scene; generating glow by blurring the selected area image to produce a glowing area image; and adding the glowing area image to the scene to provide the glow effect, wherein the selecting comprises: rendering the scene to provide a rendered scene image; creating a mask that defines the area which is to glow; and applying the mask to the rendered scene image to produce the selected area image.
